evidence.observation: Ramp tracked setpoint closely; brief overshoot to 759.7 °C at growth start, then settled to 749.5–750.6 °C at the 750 °C setpoint
Growth-stage power steady at about 43–45% after the overshoot, consistent with holding temperature
Ar flow matched setpoint throughout (200 sccm during purge, about 100 sccm during ramp and growth)
Tube pressure gauge and exhaust O2 sensor not installed; growth stage requires both to verify the atmosphere
